scenarios.reason: Ready for operator UAT; not accepted yet.

details.sourceState: Dirty working-tree UAT candidate based on the recorded commit; not a clean hosted candidate, tag or formal release. No commit, push, publication or sandbox deployment performed.
details.artifactContinuity: The same frozen archive was used for final real-App suites, cutover rehearsal, P16 and both deployments. All four binaries and runtime helper/App scripts match the checkout. Four source manifests had whitespace-only cleanup after freezing (Edge, Firefox, Kate, KWrite); parsed JSON equality was verified. Docs and test harnesses were subsequently completed. A formal release requires a clean committed candidate and its normal gates.
details.requirements: SVC-001 through SVC-010; bwrap, Docker and audio excluded.
details.knownVulnerabilities: Source call-graph and all four packaged binaries: none found by the pinned govulncheck gate.
details.cutover: Old local desktop exited gracefully; persistent HOME/profile/configuration intent retained. Old runtime IDs are not redirected. Retired registry directories remain recoverable; no broad state/HOME deletion. Only disposable test Apps were force-stopped or fault-injected.
failureDisposition: Initial D-Bus readiness flags were invalid; corrected to dbus-send --bus=ADDRESS and verified against real buses.
Fault injection exposed App-ready versus supervisor-ready startup race; Manager now commits only joint readiness. Original startup generation/deadline are persisted and resumed after Manager loss.
GTK can exit itself after private D-Bus loss. Supervisor now preserves the infrastructure cause rather than reporting a clean user exit; no transparent App-survival claim.

One early Firefox raw-key readback was empty after a fixed 100 ms wait; cause was not established. Added bounded observable readback without resending the key and failure diagnostics. Final exact-archive run passed all 18 focus rounds, 54 raw-key readbacks and 108 sendText readbacks.
An exploratory document test collided with another live suite's dynamic X display allocation. Final suites ran serially and passed; ports alone do not isolate display allocation.
Expanded user-home harness initially reused a generation from before logout and correctly received 409. It now uses the returned post-login generation; final run passed.
Cutover harness initially requested disallowed Mousepad idle overrides. Policy was moved into its disposable fixture; no product override rules were relaxed.
Immutable staging test contained a hardcoded old Mousepad version. It now reads the manifest; staged byte-tamper and rollback gates pass.
Initial performance counter included the existing AT-SPI D-Bus as a duplicate session bus. Final counter separates the owned session endpoint and retains total D-Bus count; thresholds unchanged.
Sensitive-data check matched a scenario label suffix as a token pattern. Renamed only that label; no credential finding or scanner weakening.

New local XFCE IBus log contains a portal activation warning. Its runtime-private IBus protocol and selected remote-unicode engine were verified; portal mode/Flatpak is not selected. This warning is not claimed fixed. Native-IME UAT remains pending.
